sloka: उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा गिरिम् प्रसवण आकुलम् ।कच्चित् क्षिति भृताम् नाथ दृष्टा सर्वांग सुंदरीम् ॥३-६४-२९॥
transliteration: uvāca rāmo dharmātmā girim prasavaṇa ākulam ।kaccit kṣiti bhṛtām nātha dṛṣṭā sarvāṁga suṁdarīm ॥3-64-29॥

translations.english: O king of the mountains have you seen a lady with beautiful limbs separated from me in this forest tract ?
